description: Create a new VM service instance from a plan (product_version_id) with either a standard OS install, SSH-key access, or restore-from-snapshot.
Get full service/VM detail: status, plan, location, access info, and the lifecycle actions currently available.
Create a new VM snapshot (account-wide v2 API).
List your account-wide VM snapshots — used to pick a snapshot_code for restore-from-snapshot when creating a VM.
Get a single account-wide snapshot’s details.
Account profile and quota info, including numVmLimit — check this before creating a VM.
List available VM plans, providers, locations, and operating systems — used to pick a product_version_id and selections for a create request.
Check available account balance against an optional minimum required amount before creating or starting a VM.
Billing summary, including runway_days — an estimate of how many days the current balance will last at the account’s burn rate.
Update the VM’s name and/or description. At least one field is required.
List service instances (VMs). Filter with service_type=vm and compare meta.active_total against numVmLimit to check quota before creating a VM.
Run a lifecycle action on the VM (start, stop, reboot, delete, resize, snapshot, change_ip, rebuild, rescue) as a queued async operation.
List recent operations (activity log) for this VM; optional status filter.
Dry-run a resize to a target plan: preview billing delta and warnings before executing it via the resize lifecycle action.
List plans this VM can resize to (upgrade/downgrade), with pricing for each option.
Restore/overwrite the VM’s disk from a snapshot. Destructive to the current disk state; the snapshot must be ready/available and synced with the provider.
Create a new snapshot of this VM (service-scoped); may incur a one-time fee per the plan’s snapshot price component.
Delete a snapshot belonging to this VM’s service instance.
List snapshots for this VM’s service instance.
Get the status of a single operation by its operation_id.
List snapshots across all of your account’s VMs, with serviceId when the snapshot is linked to a service instance.
Delete an account-wide snapshot (v2 API).
Register a new SSH public key for key-based VM access.
Delete a registered SSH public key.
List your registered SSH public keys.
Provide access details (e.g. password) for a VM. Returns null for the password field when the VM was provisioned with SSH-key access instead.
